name: Specter
blurb: Sweeps for a hidden 13.56 MHz NFC reader buried in an ATM or card terminal — using nothing but the Flipper's own antenna.

name: VMware Hidden Mode
blurb: 13 tiers of VMX patching plus guest cleanup, so malware stops noticing it's being watched in a lab.

name: RollCall
blurb: Press your own key fob and *prove* the rolling code actually rolls. Graded A/B/C/F.

name: GhostTag
blurb: Anti-stalking tracker hunter — tells you an AirTag has been *following you*, not merely that one exists.

name: Nyx
blurb: Finds covert night-vision cameras by the infrared light they leak — and is honest about the ones it can't.

name: Sibyl

name: Sinon
blurb: AI agent pentest kit — a 54-probe corpus for prompt injection, tool abuse and over-permission, with canary-verified verdicts.

blurb: My full roadmap to OSCP — the companion to the PEN-200 series on the channel.
